name: ScreenSpot
intro: ScreenSpot是SeeClick提出的原始GUI定位基准，包含移动端、桌面端和网页的真实界面截图及英文操作指令，评估模型能否把目标元素定位到正确可点击区域；它不是ScreenSpot-Pro。
org: 南京大学, 上海人工智能实验室
build_method: 4位标注者采集截图, 边界框与英文指令标注
eval_feature: 移动端桌面端网页, 文本与图标控件定位
scale: 600多张截图, 1200多条指令, 5种系统/环境
build_method_en: Four-annotator Screenshot Collection, Bounding Boxes, English Commands
eval_feature_en: Mobile, Desktop, Web, Text and Icon/Widget Grounding
intro_en: ScreenSpot is the original GUI-grounding benchmark introduced with SeeClick. It pairs realistic mobile, desktop, and web screenshots with English commands to test whether a model locates the correct clickable region; it is not ScreenSpot-Pro.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with SeeClick arXiv:2401.10935 Section 4 and Appendix B; official njucckevin/SeeClick repository. ScreenSpot is the original GUI-grounding benchmark introduced with SeeClick, not ScreenSpot-Pro. Four experienced computer-science annotators are assigned mobile, desktop, or web GUI types, capture screenshots during routine use, annotate frequently used clickable regions with bounding boxes, and write English commands. Mobile and desktop cases use common apps and operations; web cases cover development, shopping, forum, and tool sites from WebArena. Interfaces and elements are English, and personal information is removed. The final benchmark contains over 600 screenshots and more than 1,200 instructions across iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, and web, with text and icon/widget labels. Models receive a screenshot and instruction; output coordinates, or bounding-box centers, become predicted points. Click accuracy counts a hit when the point falls inside the ground-truth box and is reported by platform and element type.
